text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a comprehensive topical review paper focused on climate-change impacts and adaptation studies for the water sector in Thailand. While it covers multiple sub-sectors including riverine hydrology, sediment erosion, coastal erosion, forest hydrology, agricultural hydrology, and urban hydrology, it does not focus primarily on land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation. The review notes that projections of climate and hydrological variables exist but acknowledges the lack of systematic multi-model and multi-scenario assessments and limited spatial coverage. Although land-use changes are discussed as non-climatic drivers impacting hydrology and runoff, the paper does not present or synthesize quantitative national-scale spatial LULC future predictions with mapped outputs or accuracy metrics. Therefore, it does not meet the core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction research. It is a review article but not focused on LULC future prediction, so per categorization flow, it is EXCLUDED.)
